plan.summary: Browser-based Space Fractions game built with Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL, simplified from microservices to a single deployable service. The app serves a static HTML/JS frontend covering intro, gameplay, score, help, and admin question management, backed by REST APIs and a PostgreSQL database. Includes OpenAPI contract, gRPC contract, SQL DDL, Kubernetes manifest, and traceability matrix.

notes: Simplified microservices to a single Node.js/Express service with static frontend to reduce deployment complexity; original components (Game, Question, User) are implemented as internal modules.
Redis, RabbitMQ, and Elasticsearch are omitted; in-memory caching and synchronous request handling are used for simplicity.
Authentication is simplified to basic user registration and login without OAuth2; admin role is inferred from a boolean flag.
The spec referenced sql/question_ddl.sql in ASR-1 but did not list it; both sql/game_ddl.sql and sql/question_ddl.sql are included to satisfy traceability.
AdminComponent mentioned in component diagram but not in architecture text; implemented as admin.html UI and question management APIs.
All SQL DDL tables (users, games, questions) are created to ensure real database runs work.
Frontend screens are implemented as separate static HTML files (index, game, score, help, admin) served by Express.

message: Generated the complete Space Fractions project: a browser-based fractions game built with Node.js/Express and PostgreSQL, simplified from microservices to a single deployable service. Delivered all manifest files including documentation (README.md, architecture.md, openapi.yaml, internal.proto, traceability_matrix.csv), SQL DDL (game_ddl.sql, question_ddl.sql), Kubernetes manifest, Dockerfile, full backend (server, app, db, routes, controllers, services, models), static frontend (index/game/score/help/admin HTML + CSS + JS), and tests (unit + integration). All 27 tests pass using the Node built-in test runner with stubbed/mocked data layers (no external services required).
